errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Something about this request didn't work. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This no longer exists, it may have been deleted in another window. Reload the page.
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This action isn't possible here. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED_CLIENT: The server rejected this request. Check INTERNAL_TOKEN in .env and restart the app.
errors.SERVICE_STARTING: The app is still starting. This usually takes a few seconds.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: This file is larger than {max_mb} MB. Split it or use a smaller version.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This format isn't supported. You can add PDF, TXT, Markdown and HTML files.

errors.EMPTY_FILE: This file is empty. Choose a different file.
errors.DUPLICATE_DOCUMENT: This file is already in your library. You can use it right away.
errors.STORAGE_QUOTA: Your library reached its {max_mb} MB limit. Remove a document to make room.
errors.STORAGE_FULL: The disk is full. Free up some space or remove documents.
errors.UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE: The upload was interrupted. Please try again.
errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_READY: This document is still being processed. It'll be ready shortly.
errors.DOCUMENT_FILE_MISSING: The original file is gone. Please add the document again.
errors.DELETE_FAILED: Deleting didn't fully work. Try again, anything already removed stays removed.
errors.RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE: This part of the file doesn't exist. Reload the view.
errors.PDF_ENCRYPTED: This PDF is password protected. Save a copy without a password and add it again.
errors.PDF_CORRUPT: This PDF can't be opened and may be damaged. Export it again and retry.
errors.PDF_NO_TEXT: We couldn't find readable text in this PDF, it's probably a scan. Use a version with a text layer or a sharper copy.
errors.PDF_TOO_MANY_PAGES: This PDF has more pages than the app can process. Split it into smaller files.
errors.TEXT_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED: We can't read this file's text encoding. Save it as UTF-8 and add it again.
errors.DOCUMENT_EMPTY: We couldn't find any text in this file. Choose a file that contains text.
errors.DOCUMENT_TOO_LONG: This document is too long. Split it into smaller files.
errors.PROCESSING_TIMEOUT: Processing took too long. Try again or split the file.
errors.PROCESSING_FAILED: Something went wrong while processing. Please try again.
errors.PROCESSING_INTERRUPTED: Processing was interrupted by a restart. Just start it again.
errors.MALWARE_DETECTED: The virus check found malware in this file and deleted it right away. Get a clean copy from a trusted source.
errors.MALWARE_SCAN_FAILED: The virus check could not check this file, so it was not added to be safe. Try again.
errors.CHAT_NOT_FOUND: This chat no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another window.
errors.CHAT_BUSY: An answer is still being written in this chat. Wait a moment or stop it.
errors.CHAT_LIMIT: You have {max} chats. Delete older ones to start a new chat.
errors.MESSAGE_LIMIT: This chat has gotten very long. Start a new chat for more questions.
errors.MESSAGE_NOT_LATEST: You can only regenerate the answer to the latest question. Just ask your question again.
errors.DUPLICATE_REQUEST: This question is already on its way.
errors.CONCURRENCY_LIMIT: {max} answers are already running. You can continue as soon as one finishes.

errors.DOCUMENTS_NOT_READY: Your documents are still being processed. You can ask as soon as one is ready.
errors.QUESTION_EMPTY: Type a question to get started.
errors.QUESTION_TOO_LONG: Your question is longer than {max} characters. Please shorten it a little.
errors.MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED: This model isn't available here. Choose another one above.
errors.COMPARE_SAME_MODEL: Both columns use the same model. Choose two different models to compare.
errors.TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: This demo's daily budget is used up. You can ask again from {time}.
errors.LLM_AUTH: The Claude API key isn't accepted. Check it under Settings > Models.
errors.LLM_BILLING: The API account's credit or spend limit has been reached. Check billing in the Claude Console.
errors.LLM_FORBIDDEN: This API key can't use the selected model. Pick another model or check access in the Claude Console.
errors.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: {model} isn't available right now. Choose another model.
errors.LLM_RATE_LIMITED: Claude is receiving too many requests from this account. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.LLM_OVERLOADED: Claude is very busy right now. Try again in a few seconds or use another model.
errors.LLM_UNAVAILABLE: Claude had a problem just now. Please try again shortly.
errors.LLM_TIMEOUT: Claude took too long to respond. Please try again.
errors.LLM_UNREACHABLE: Can't reach Claude right now. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.LLM_BAD_REQUEST: The request to Claude was invalid. That's on the app. Start a new chat and try there.
errors.LLM_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE: This conversation has gotten too long. Please start a new chat.
errors.LLM_EMPTY_ANSWER: No answer came back. Please try again.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the app right now. Check that it's still running and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something unexpected happened. Please try again.
errors.STREAM_INTERRUPTED: The connection dropped before the answer was finished. Please try again.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Quick pause. You can continue in {seconds, plural, one {one second} other {# seconds}}.
errors.pageNotFound: This page doesn't exist. The address may have changed.
errors.API_KEY_INVALID: Anthropic doesn't accept this key. Check it in the Anthropic Console and paste it again.

notices.PAGES_WITHOUT_TEXT: {count, plural, one {# page has no text, probably scanned. It won't be searched.} other {# pages have no text, probably scanned. They won't be searched.}}

notices.PDF_ACTIVE_CONTENT: This PDF contains active content such as scripts. The app only reads the text and runs nothing.
notices.SCANNER_STARTING: The virus check is still starting. The file will be checked in a moment.
notices.SCANNER_UNAVAILABLE: The virus check is not reachable right now. The file waits until it is back.
notices.SOURCES_PARTIAL: {count, plural, one {# document is still processing and isn't included in this answer.} other {# documents are still processing and aren't included in this answer.}}
notices.SUMMARY_PARTIAL: There is too much text for a full summary. The answer is based on the most relevant passages.
notices.NO_CITATIONS: This answer has no citations. Please double-check it.
notices.ANSWER_TRUNCATED: The answer was very long and got cut off.
notices.LLM_REFUSED: Claude can't answer this request. Feel free to rephrase it.
notices.LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED: Without an API key we show the matching passages from your documents, but no answer.
notices.MODEL_SWITCHED: This answer was written by {new} instead of {old}.

privacy.intro: Short and honest: what happens to your data.
privacy.localDocuments: Your documents, their text and the search data.
privacy.localProcessing: Text recognition for scans and the virus scan. Both run here, without a cloud service.
privacy.localName: Your name. It is only used for the greeting.
privacy.sent: Goes to Anthropic in the USA
privacy.sentQuestion: For an answer, your question, the latest messages of the chat and the matching passages from your documents go to Claude.
privacy.sentSmall: If your selection is small, the whole document goes along. The answer's details then say so.
privacy.sentNever: Your name and the files themselves are never sent.
privacy.anthropicText: According to its policy, Anthropic keeps API requests for up to 30 days, for example to detect abuse, and does not train models on them.
privacy.telemetryText: The app loads no fonts, scripts or images from other servers and collects no usage data. The built-in telemetry of Next.js, Hugging Face and onnxruntime is switched off.
privacy.scanOn: ClamAV checks every file on this computer before it enters the library.
privacy.rightsText: You can export everything and delete it at any time. A deleted document also disappears from the chats that cite it.
privacy.retentionOn: Chats and documents are deleted automatically after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.

about.modelsFooter: Prices in US dollars according to Anthropic. What an answer cost is shown in its details.
